chunks: Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad ibn Abī Naṣr narrated from al-Riḍā عليه السلام, who said:
A boy is instructed to perform salat (prayer) when he is seven years old, and a woman does not cover her hair from him until he reaches puberty.

key_terms.بِالصَّلَاةِ: with salat (prayer), meaning being made to observe prayer
key_terms.يُؤْخَذُ: is to be instructed or taken to task

ai.seo_question: At what age should a boy be instructed to perform salat (prayer), and when must a woman cover her hair in front of him?
ai.summary: This hadith states that a boy is to be instructed in salat (prayer) from the age of seven. It also states that a woman is not required to cover her hair from him until he reaches puberty, indicating a legal distinction tied to childhood and maturity.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4507 - Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr narrated from Imam Ali ibn Musa Ar-Ridha (as), who said: "
A boy is instructed to perform prayer when he is seven years old, and a woman is not required to cover her hair in front of him until he reaches puberty."
